notes.title: Boring January News #NumbDevLog 02
notes.content:
Over the past few months, a significant effort has been directed towards making every aspect of [b]Numb [/b]coherent and cohesive. It's been a journey of meticulously crafting the art style, ensuring it not only creates the right atmosphere but also aligns seamlessly with the gameplay.

[previewyoutube=f7xA_qyfakc;full][/previewyoutube]

A key aspect of this endeavor was the implementation of dithering, a technique used to create texture and gradients in pixel art. The choice was not just for its aesthetic appeal but also for its ability to subtly conceal elements beyond the player's immediate reach, enhancing the game's mysterious and immersive environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44310505/7b4dc11fc39de1a11609e3355df95b29859078d3.png[/img]

The game's menu underwent a comprehensive overhaul. I redesigned each tab to be stylistically consistent and to accommodate the final system features that were in development. This was an essential step in ensuring that every element of the game felt integrated and intuitive to the player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44310505/7b4dc11fc39de1a11609e3355df95b29859078d3.png[/img]

I've also reorganized the game elements to ensure clarity and sharpness, but only when the player is in close proximity to them. This approach adds a layer of depth and discovery, encouraging players to explore and interact closely with the game world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44310505/b76704bac9613ce2844bf7aadcea7847e77b4cc1.png[/img]

In non-development-related news, some publishers have shown interest in Numb. I'm currently discussing a couple of potential deals, which could help in increasing Numb's marketing reach - discoverability is a real pain in the a** for any indie dev without a budget.

If you want to help, consider [url=https://linktr.ee/numbgame]following Numb on social media[/url] and spreading the news to any moody friend of yours looking to make their day worse by playing Numb.

- Walter

notes.title: Demo update
notes.content:
We have updated the demo build of Numb to provide a better user experience with fewer distractions on the interface side of things.

[h2]📄 Changelog:[/h2]

[list]
[*] The interface now aligns with the progression of the storyline:
[list]
[*] The bullet bar is not shown until the gun is obtained
[*] The courage bar has been hidden
[/list]
[*] Some features that are supposed to be activated later in the plot have been removed to avoid confusion, such as:
[list]
[*] The ability to close one's eyes to escape dangers
[*] The ability to crouch
[/list]
[*] Hazards in the last part of the demo have been repositioned to teach the player the shooting mechanic, requiring them to load and fire to progress, thus avoiding the sense of frustration many encountered when unable to complete the demo
[*] It is now easier to escape from the unknown and return home
[*] Fixed some issues related to auto-movement in scripted sections
[*] Rebalanced sanity consumption to make it more fair
[*] Other minor bug fixes
[/list]



As usual, we invite you to wishlist the game and try out the demo 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458780/Numb__Just_dont_think_about_it/
